entities.summary: Vyacheslav Grigorevich Domani was a Russian former volleyball player who competed for the Soviet Union in the 1972 Summer Olympics. In 1972, he was part of the Soviet team which won the bronze medal in the Olympic tournament. He played all seven matches. His son Dmitri Domani played basketball professionally.
